decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the _north and south flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - REASON FOR  APPROVAL:
The proposal is in keeping with the character of the local area and will not result in a detrimental impact upon the amenity of the neighbouring properties. The size of the extension adequately addresses the relevant policies of the  Unitary Development Plan. These policies include ENV - 1.1, H.1.2  and H.3.4  of the Unitary Development Plan  1996  and ENV - B.1.1,  H.4.1 and H.6.4 of the  Adopted Unitary Development   2003.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
